en-US.author: Mike Fährmann
en-US.description: Command-line program to download image galleries and collections from several image hosting sites
en-US.longDescription: gallery-dl is a command-line program to download image galleries and collections from several image hosting sites. It is a cross-platform tool with many configuration options and powerful filenaming capabilities.
en-US.name: gallery-dl
en-US.releaseNotes:
Extractors
- Additions
  - [goonbox] add user extractor (pr#535)
- deviantart
  - fix avatar URLs for usernames with dashes (cb#555)
- erome
  - fix Referer header for file downloads (pr#536)
- exhentai
  - extract comments metadata (cb#523)
  - fix Multi-Page Viewer detection (cb#551)
- idolcomplex
  - support iapi.sankakucomplex.com URLs (gh#9833)
- imagepond
  - support expired item pages (pr#512)
- inkbunny
  - handle expired Results ID errors (gh#9810)
- instagram
  - automatically collect relay parameters (cb#543 cb#545 cb#548 cb#552 cb#557 gh#9829 gh#9834 gh#9839)
  - update _user_by_id_impl variables (cb#542 cb#543 pr#541)
- kagane
  - support mirror domains (cb#538)
  - fix extractors
- mixdrop
  - support mxdrop.click URLs (cb#556)
- newgrounds
  - fix comment extraction for art posts (cb#534)
- nhentai
  - use API with optional auth key (pr#483)
- pawchive
  - fix temp_url files without "deferred": true marker
- piczel
  - update API URLs (cb#553)
- pillowfort
  - fix pagination logic (cb#539)
- pornpics
  - fix URLs with -1 suffix (cb#530)
  - fix pagination and metadata extraction
- tiktok
  - preserve base64 padding in JS challenge cookie (cb#549)
- twitter
  - fix search-limit option (cb#529)
  - fix KeyError: 'legacy' for quote Tweet chains (gh#9822)
  - fix errors with deleted (quoted) Tweets (gh#9822)
Requirements
- update package versions
- respect locked dependency versions
Miscellaneous
- disable cookies-select when using --cookies or --cookies-from-browser command-line options
